INSIDE THE LYRICS

A wish made through regret

  • Regret
  • Wishing someone well

Memories arrive before the speaker has chosen to revisit them. The lyric’s wish for the other person to feel less sad is complicated by an admission of having been absorbed in their own feelings. Looking back brings affection and responsibility together.

That regret changes the force of the title. The reassurance can be heard as a hope for someone’s happiness from someone conscious of their own past selfishness. The wish is modest: to let a memory bring a smile again, even with regret still attached to it.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 화이트유즈드삭스

WhiteUsedSocks

WhiteUsedSocks are a Korean rock band, with expressive vocals at the heart of their songs.

The band began releasing music in 2017. “Don’t feel sad” is one of their early singles.
